value.name: Daniel laments sacrifices and regrets
value.description: Daniel expresses that his sacrifices may leave him with only memories and regrets.
evidence: "...that won't leave me with nothing but memories and regrets."

value.name: Asha reassures Daniel about honoring legacy
value.description: Asha promises Daniel that his sacrifices will not be wasted and urges decisions rooted in understanding and respect for her legacy.
evidence: Asha: "I hear you, Daniel, and I promise we won’t let your sacrifices go in vain; let’s ensure that our decisions today are rooted in understanding and respect for her legacy, so you don’t have to face those regrets alone."

value.name: Daniel reveals worsening financial pressure
value.description: Daniel says his financial situation is deteriorating and frames the conflict as a matter of survival, not just memory.
evidence: Daniel: "I appreciate that, Asha, but I can’t shake the feeling that while we’re stuck in this emotional quagmire, my financial reality is only getting worse—this isn't just about memories for me; it's about survival."

value.name: Asha offers to navigate situation together
value.description: Asha tells Daniel they can face the emotional and practical issues together while honoring their mother and securing his future.
evidence: Asha: "I understand that, and I want you to know that we can navigate this together; facing our emotions doesn't mean ignoring your reality—it's about finding a way to honor her while securing your future."

value.name: Daniel urges immediate action
value.description: Daniel warns that delay could leave him without a future and says sentimentality must not obscure the stakes.
evidence: Daniel: "I get that, but if we don’t act fast, I might not have a future to secure; I can’t afford to let sentimentality cloud what’s really at stake here."

value.name: Asha insists choices reflect mother's values
value.description: Asha argues that every decision should be anchored in their mother's values and asks them to reflect on what she truly wanted before acting.
evidence: Asha: "Daniel, I know the stakes are high, but we owe it to ourselves and to our mother to ensure that every choice we make is anchored in her values; let's reflect on what she truly wanted for us before we take that leap."

value.name: Daniel rejects reflection as unaffordable
value.description: Daniel says he cannot afford the time for reflection and wants them to act before his financial fears become real.
evidence: Daniel: "I get it, but reflecting on what she wanted feels like a luxury I can't afford right now; I just need us to act before my financial fears become a reality."
